name: Tori Karumu
source:
"Nice to meet you, senpai."

A first-year high school student who joined the Gardening Club. 

The feelings that make her turn back into a beast are "jealousy" and "anxiety." However, she never transformed into one even in childhood.

Although gentle, she's also very shy and sensitive. She sometimes acts strange, but there may be a reason for that...?

[spoiler]According to Moko, she originally thought he was a "graceful and cute girl." He became abnormally attached to her because she treated him so kindly. The ribbon she gave to him is his greatest treasure.[/spoiler]

Her favorite food is barley rice. Due to being a bird, she is able to imitate people's voices and sing very well, but she prefers not to show it off.

[Translated from in-game profile]
